description: This file defines a custom exception class named SyncInboundEmailAccountsNoMethodException, which extends the base Exception class. It is used within the SuiteCRM project to represent a specific error condition related to inbound email account synchronization without defining additional methods.

classes.name: SyncInboundEmailAccountsNoMethodException
classes.description: A custom exception class used to signal errors related to missing methods in inbound email account synchronization within SuiteCRM.
